projects.title: Lycan
projects.description:
An online tug-of-war arena built in Unity3D where Lycans are pitted against Monks. Prototype inherited from another group and remastered.

Lycan is an online battle arena game where Lycans and Monks are set against each other. This project has been passed through many teams. When it had reached ours, it was in rough shape as far as the codebase went. Our team reprogrammed the entire game so that it could be expanded upon as well as make much needed network optimizations.

My Contributions
* Rework of type system
* Various Bug Fixes
* Deathcam
* Assist with rebuild of code

projects.title: Cyclops
projects.description:
Cyclops is an on the rails shooter. The game is built with Unity and features the Occulus as the main focal feature.
You are Cyclops. You find yourself in a hangar with no idea how you got there. You start walking around to check out the place. Suddenly, army men start shooting at you. You defend yourself, by shooting lasers out of your eyes, and try to get through the hangar without dying.

My Roles:
Level Design
Asset Design
Minor Scripting
